LibTmux

Description

Capture tmux state in IO and process detached observations with ordinary Haskell collections. Start with withServer and capture; navigation and field access from LibTmux.Snapshot perform no external operations. renameSession, renameWindow and setPaneTitle act on explicit references in IO; detached observations change only when acquired again with capture. createSession returns the actual initial references; LibTmux.Creation describes its options and historical receipt. Capture again for observations.

LibTmux.Server documents ownership and failure recovery. Typed IDs, checked dimensions and supported releases have their own pure modules. LibTmux.Query provides qualified typed descriptions over the same snapshots; query source names are separate from collection access here.
